item.text: “I’m really enjoying having you here, and I love spending time together. I’ve realized I need about an hour to myself each afternoon to recharge—it’s part of my usual routine, not anything you’ve done. Would you mind if I took some quiet time around three each day? Please make yourself at home, relax, or explore a bit—whatever you’d enjoy. Then we can catch up afterward. I wanted to mention it so my disappearing for a while doesn’t feel unfriendly.”
